FLEET-2 (3965900e, O4 row 1, operator ruling 2026-10-03) made update_sql a full rescan with a NULL-out arm (scripts/lib/compute/link-neighbourhoods.js:103-106): every stamped permit is re-derived, so the 9,017 stamped permits with null coordinates were un-stamped (stamped_permits_with_null_coordinates 9017 → 0; permits_linked_cumulative 240947 → 231930, exactly −9,017) and the 5,138 mislinks were re-stamped (linked_permit_outside_its_own_neighbourhood 5138 → 0). neighbourhood_id_unreachable_no_coords 1493 → 13499 = +9,017 un-stamped + 2,989 coordinate-less permits that newly reach a geometry-bearing parcel (its SQL requires a permit_parcels link; parcels grew 486,530 → 496,536 and link_parcels re-checks every permit).

permits row count is unchanged (254,082 PRE and POST); the hash moves because neighbourhood_id changed on the rows the FLEET-2 full-rescan NULL-out arm un-stamped (9,017) and re-stamped (5,138 mislinks), per the invariants[].value entry (3965900e, link-neighbourhoods.js:103-106).
